# JUDO GenModel Generator

> An Eclipse plugin that generates JUDO runtime helper classes for EMF GenModels — producing type-safe Java wrapper classes with fluent builder APIs, load/save operations, and validation support.

Key facts:
- Java 21 (compiler targets Java 11 bytecode via Tycho)
- Maven 3.9.4 with Tycho 4.0.13 (Eclipse PDE build) and Xtext/Xtend 2.39.0
- 3 modules: core plugin, Eclipse Feature, P2 Update Site
- Uses Xtend templates, MWE2 workflow orchestration, and Guice dependency injection
- Part of the JUDO NG platform by BlackBelt Technology
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, architecture diagrams, and build commands
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with directory structure, build commands, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, submission process, and contribution guidelines

## Modules — Generator Plugin

- [runtimemodel/pom.xml](runtimemodel/pom.xml): Core OSGi bundle containing the code generation engine — MWE2 workflow, Guice DI module, Xtend templates, and naming utilities

## Modules — Distribution

- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse Feature that packages the runtimemodel plugin for installation
- [site/category.xml](site/category.xml): P2 Update Site aggregating features into a deployable repository
